missing_synthetic_intervals.meaning: All six absent intervals are silently omitted by the max predicate.

uncertain_synthetic_cost.meaning: Point estimates pass although each upper bound permits >2% harm.

fallback_label_counterexample.meaning: Whole-corpus regression can be entirely on accepted run-path blocks, with zero fallback regression.

nominal_cycles.meaning: Displayed M3 uses wall seconds times a sampled/default frequency, not PMU cycles.

overshoot_bound.meaning: Each short cell emits a whole AVX2 store; identical final 4n-byte tables need not have identical store work.
